name: Wuhan Huazhong Numerical Control Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuhan Huazhong Numerical Control Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells CNC controllers and industrial robots in China and internationally. It offers CNC controllers, such as CNC lathe and milling controllers, CNC grinding machine controllers, and CNC drives and motors; and industrial robots, including collaborative and welding robotic arms, machine loading and unloading robots, palletizing robot arms, spray painting robot arms, assembly robot arms, pick and place robotic arms, and stamping robotic arms.
